data.name: Blazing Strike: R.Evolution
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The fight for the future is far from over.

Blazing Strike: R.Evolution is the high-octane successor to the cult-classic 2D fighter, evolving the series into an epic, handcrafted beat ‘em up. Featuring stunning high-definition sprite animations and a fluid combat system, R.Evolution blends the nostalgic soul of 90s arcades with modern technical precision.

THE STORY

The hard-won peace established by our protagonists was a fragile illusion. Beneath the surface of a recovering world, a shadow is lengthening—something darker, older, and far more dangerous is imminent.

Join Jake and his crew as they emerge from the underground to traverse a dystopian landscape. From neon-drenched city streets to industrial wastelands, the gang must fight their way to the heart of the conspiracy before the world's light is extinguished for good.

KEY FEATURES

  • Hand-Painted HD Sprites: Experience incredibly fluid combat through meticulously handcrafted, high-definition character animations that bring every punch, kick, and special move to life.

  • Deep Narrative Campaign: Follow Jake’s journey in a comprehensive Story Mode, featuring cinematic encounters and character-driven stakes.

  • Classic Arcade Action: Test your endurance in Arcade Mode, fighting through waves of enemies and grueling boss encounters.

  • Co-op: Up to 4 players. You can be a lone wolf or go to battle with your friends.

  • The Dojo: Sharpen your skills in a robust Training Mode to master combos and frame-perfect parries.

  • Customize Your Fighter: (TBD) Express your style with a deep Character Color Palette Editor.

  • Brawl Together: (TBD) Take the fight global with Online Co-op and local Versus Mode.

MISC

  • The game will be Steam Deck verified.

  • Unlockable characters

  • More details of the game will be shared soon.

data.short_description: The fight continues in Blazing Strike: R.Evolution. This handcrafted HD beat 'em up brings Jake and his gang back to the streets to face a new, darker threat. Featuring fluid sprite-based combat, a deep Story Mode, and classic arcade action—handcrafted for the ultimate brawl.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 @3.0GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4440
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard or onboard chipset
